original.statement: The metrics rootCertExpiryTimestamp and certChainExpiryTimestamp no longer record a negative number for expired certs/chains (docs corrected to match actual behavior); users should check the signs of rootCertExpirySeconds and certChainExpirySeconds instead.

decision.reason: [ev-c3da9e3c81f1] says the timestamp metrics not recording negative numbers "was never the actual behavior" and that only "the docs are now updated to reflect the actual behavior". The runtime semantics of `rootCertExpiryTimestamp` and `certChainExpiryTimestamp` did not change in 1.24.0. Only the documentation was corrected, so "behavior-changed" misreads the text. The evidence does not support any change assertion about this subject.
